spec.query:
SELECT last("pnl") AS last_pnl 
        FROM "default"."acct_lvl_daily_pnl"
        WHERE ("label" =~/^$label$/)
        AND $timeFilter
        GROUP BY time($__interval), "label" fill(none)

SELECT last("pnl") AS last_pnl 
        FROM "default"."acct_lvl_daily_pnl"
        WHERE ("label" =~/^$label$/)
        AND $timeFilter
        GROUP BY time($__interval), label fill(none)
SELECT last("trade_vol") FROM "default"."acct_lvl_daily_trade_vol" WHERE ( "label" =~/^$label$/ AND $timeFilter) GROUP BY time($__interval), "label" fill(none)
SELECT last("trade_vol") FROM "acct_lvl_daily_trade_vol" WHERE ("label" =~/^$label$/ ) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "label" fill(none)
SELECT last("grp_risk") FROM "acct_lvl_grp_risk" WHERE ("label" =~ /^$label$/ ) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "label" fill(none)
SELECT last("grp_risk") FROM "acct_lvl_grp_risk" WHERE ("label" =~ /^$label$/ ) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "label" fill(none)

SELECT last("pnl") FROM "default"."acct_lvl_daily_pnl" WHERE ("level" =~ /^(2)$/ AND "label" =~ /^DLP--.*$/ AND "label" !~ /^DLP--UPTIME.*$/ AND "label" !~ /^DLP--VOLUME.*$/ AND "label" !~ /^DLP--BITVAVO.*$/  )  AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "label" fill(none)

SELECT ("AskSignal" - "BidSignal")/(("AskSignal" +"BidSignal")/2) From
(SELECT "AskSignal" as "AskSignal", "BidSignal" as "BidSignal" 
FROM "StrategySignal" WHERE ("strategy" =~ /^$Strategy$/) AND $timeFilter)

SELECT ("AskSignal" - "BidSignal")/(("AskSignal" +"BidSignal")/2) From
(SELECT "AskSignal" as "AskSignal", "BidSignal" as "BidSignal" 
FROM "StrategySignal" WHERE ("strategy" =~ /^$Strategy$/) AND $timeFilter)

SELECT last("grp_risk") FROM "acct_lvl_grp_risk" WHERE ( "level" =~/^(2)$/ AND "label" =~ /^DLP--.*$/ AND "label" !~ /^DLP--UPTIME.*$/ AND "label" !~ /^DLP--VOLUME.*$/ AND "label" !~ /^DLP--BITVAVO.*$/) OR ("level" =~/^(3)$/ AND "label" =~ /^DLP--PRELAUNCH--MM--.*$/ ) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "label" fill(none)

SELECT last("pnl") FROM "default"."acct_lvl_daily_pnl" WHERE ("level" =~ /^(2)$/ AND "label" =~ /^DLP--.*$/ AND "label" !~ /^DLP--UPTIME.*$/ AND "label" !~ /^DLP--BITVAVO.*$/ OR ("label"=~/^DLP--PRELAUNCH--MM.*$/ AND "level"=~/^(2)$/ ))  AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "label" fill(none)
SELECT last("grp_risk") FROM "acct_lvl_grp_risk" WHERE ( "level" =~/^(2)$/ AND "label" =~ /^DLP--.*$/ AND "label" !~ /^DLP--UPTIME.*$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "label" fill(none)
